meta.title: Org Talent Match
meta.description: Adds a "Talent match" entry to the left sidebar. Editable project requirements sync into the requirement pool; the default team configuration calls out missing roles and required skills; project alerts use a compact project × type matrix with count summaries and detailed drill-down. It also includes project progress/outcomes, product acceptance, editable talent profiles, drag-to-team org chart, one best team with a base team, local SVG charts, one-paste feedback, memo, project conversations and capability advice. Local data stays in this browser; task details are sent to DSH conversations by explicit user action, and skill-search keywords go to GitHub.
